question: For users who received badges in 2011, identify the user with the most total badges. Among all posts owned by this user, what is the display name of the user who last edited the post with the highest view count?

prediction.sql:
WITH TopBadgeUser AS (
    SELECT b."XCL_002" AS UserId
    FROM badges AS b
    WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', b."XCL_004") = '2011'
    GROUP BY b."XCL_002"
    ORDER BY COUNT(b."XCL_001") DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
TopPost AS (
    SELECT p."XCL_026" AS PostId
    FROM posts AS p
    WHERE p."XCL_033" = (SELECT UserId FROM TopBadgeUser)
    ORDER BY p."XCL_030" DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
LastEditor AS (
    SELECT ph."XCL_017" AS EditorId
    FROM postHistory AS ph
    WHERE ph."XCL_014" = (SELECT PostId FROM TopPost)
    ORDER BY ph."XCL_016" DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT u."XCL_055"
FROM users AS u
WHERE u."XCL_052" = (SELECT EditorId FROM LastEditor)
